description: Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.

b.request: For each invoice with invoice line items, calculate its average product quantity and its cost gap as the mean of the per-line ratios (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Ignore missing values when calculating averages. Keep invoices whose average quantity exceeds the overall average of invoice-level average quantities; list each invoice number, its average quantity, its mean cost gap, and the difference between its average quantity and the overall average. Sort by that difference descending, with missing values last, return the top 10, and do not round
b.sql:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
        AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS mean_cost_gap
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg_quantity
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    ia.invoice_number,
    ia.avg_quantity,
    ia.mean_cost_gap,
    ia.avg_quantity - oa.overall_avg_quantity AS quantity_difference
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.avg_quantity > oa.overall_avg_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each invoice number in the invoice line items, compute the average `product_quantity` and the average over its lines of (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that cost ratio, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages.
a.sql:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity,
    AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity
  FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
  ia.invoice_number,
  ia.average_quantity,
  ia.cost_ratio,
  ia.average_quantity - oa.overall_average_quantity AS quantity_difference
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.average_quantity > oa.overall_average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

c.request: For each invoice in the invoice line items, find its average `product_quantity` and its relative gap between product cost and total cost, i.e. (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that relative gap, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages. Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.
c.sql:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
    AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS relative_cost_gap
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity
  FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
  i.invoice_number,
  i.average_quantity,
  i.relative_cost_gap,
  i.average_quantity - o.overall_average_quantity AS quantity_above_overall_average
FROM invoice_averages AS i
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE i.average_quantity > o.overall_average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_above_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

d.request: For each invoice, calculate its cost gap as the mean of the per-line ratios `(product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost`.
d.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number;
